questions.question: Which Hanshin Tigers player captured the Nippon Professional Baseball Triple Crown in 2026?
questions.explanation: Satō claimed the NPB Triple Crown, becoming the first player to achieve the batting milestone since Murakami did so in 2022.
questions.context: 2026 Nippon Professional Baseball season: In baseball, Teruaki Satō of the Hanshin Tigers wins the Triple Crown; the last NPB Triple Crown was won by Munetaka Murakami in 2022.

questions.question: According to statements by U.S. President Donald Trump, American armed forces will refrain from attacking Iran prior to which event?
questions.explanation: Trump confirmed that the American military would hold off on any strikes against Iran until after the upcoming midterms.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war: U.S. president Donald Trump says that the U.S. military will not attack Iran before the midterm elections next month.

questions.question: Which Canadian author was awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: Carson received the literature prize for her innovative and playful body of work engaging with ancient classical traditions.
questions.context: 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature: Canadian poet Anne Carson is awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature for "her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature".

questions.story: AI boom, Semiconductor industry in Taiwan
questions.question: Surging global demand for which category of goods helped push Taiwan's monthly exports to a record $87.2 billion in September 2026?
questions.explanation: Taiwanese finance authorities attributed the unprecedented export totals to strong international demand for computer hardware tied to artificial intelligence.
questions.context: AI boom, Semiconductor industry in Taiwan: Taiwan's finance ministry reports that exports reached a record US$87.2 billion in September, while imports rose to a record $63.6 billion and the trade surplus reached a record $23.6 billion, citing demand for artificial intelligence-related hardware.

questions.question: Ahead of the arrival of Hurricane Isaias, Governor Brian Kemp declared a state of emergency in which U.S. state?
questions.explanation: Governor Kemp issued emergency orders across Georgia to prepare the state for potential impacts from the approaching hurricane.
questions.context: 2026 Atlantic hurricane season > Hurricane Isaias: In the United States, Georgia governor Brian Kemp declares a state of emergency ahead of Hurricane Isaias.
